answers.reason: The faculty administrative officer is a faculty-level staff member and does not hold a high-ranking office that grants participation in the central senate.
The faculty administrative officer manages timetables and records rather than university-wide or faculty-level budget allocations.
Selecting candidates for a professorship is an academic matter outside the scope of the faculty administrative officer's duties.
As a faculty-level administrative staff member without a high-ranking governance office, this person does not automatically hold a seat on the faculty council.
Because the officer is responsible for organizing timetables and examinations, their administrative office directly touches upon degree programme organization.
The faculty administrative officer explicitly organizes examinations and student records, making participation in the examination board part of their official remit.
The officer deals with teaching administration and records, having no responsibility for research projects or research funding.
Rewriting module descriptions affects examination organization, timetables, and records, which fall under the officer's administrative duties.
Choosing laboratory equipment is a specialized teaching and budget matter unrelated to organizing examinations, timetables, and records.
Planning the orientation week for new students involves timetabling and student enrollment records, permitting the faculty administrative officer to take part.
